title: GTFS Schedule Editor Annotation Schema
description: JSON Schema for schedule.ui.yaml, the companion file that maps each GTFS Schedule field to an editor component and its validation rules.

version.description: Annotation format version. Bump on breaking changes to this schema.

regions.description: Named geographic areas referenced by the bounding_box validation rule.

fields.description: Annotations keyed by '<file>.<field>', where <file> is the GTFS filename without the .txt extension (e.g. 'stops.stop_lat').

source.description: Where the coordinates came from. Required so the box can be re-verified rather than trusted.

component.description: Controlled vocabulary of editor components. Extend only when a field genuinely cannot be edited by an existing one.

group.description: Fields sharing a group are edited together as one widget (e.g. stop_lat + stop_lon render a single map).

references.description: For foreign_key_select: the '<file>.<field>' this field points at. Validation is row existence, not a pattern.

i18n.description: Rider-facing editor labels. Distinct from the ontology i18n overlays, which carry transliterated machine names.

validation.description: Rules derived from the GTFS spec are errors. Advisory rules carry an explicit severity.

required.description: true = always required; false = optional; 'conditional' = the spec's Conditionally Required, resolved at runtime from the field's conditions.

decimals.description: Fixed number of decimal places, or 'currency_precision' to follow the ISO 4217 precision of the field named in decimals_from.

decimals_from.description: The currency-code field that determines precision when decimals = currency_precision.

enum_from_spec.description: Options come from schedule.yaml's own `options` block. Never duplicate enum values here.

empty_means.description: Value an empty cell is equivalent to, where the spec defines one (e.g. '0 or empty').

code_list.description: External code list the value must belong to.

contrast_with.description: Companion color field this value must remain legible against.

bounding_box.description: Advisory geographic check. Defaults to a warning: a point outside the box is suspicious, not spec-invalid, and cross-border stops are legitimate.
